baslik: Apollo 1: The Fire That Happened on the Ground

sahneler.metin: Three astronauts died in a fire before their rocket left the pad.
The flames spread through the capsule in seconds.
The cabin was filled with pure oxygen, above normal pressure.
In that air, even Velcro and nylon burned like fuel.
And the hatch opened inward, held shut by the pressure.
Why? Nobody treated a ground test as dangerous.
NASA then tested every material in pure oxygen, one by one.
The Moon capsule was rebuilt around that fire.

aciklama:
On January 27, 1967, a fire in the Apollo 1 capsule killed three astronauts during a ground test. Pure oxygen, flammable materials and an inward-opening hatch left no way out.
